rubric.primary_policy: One primary per entry. acceptable_primary is evaluator ambiguity, not multiple assignment. Lands are not Ramp solely for producing mana. Functional purpose usually beats card-type fallback. Counter synergy remains a trait because Counter theme is not a primary key.
rubric.trait_policy: required_traits are minimum text-grounded semantic checks, not exhaustive or authoritative tags. Explicit synonym normalization is required.
rubric.deck_policy: Whole-deck multi-label classification: all required_categories present; all predictions within acceptable_categories; no forbidden_categories. Infinite counters requires a concrete supported repeatable loop, not counter-card counts. Combo requires a specific supported interaction, not generic synergy.
rubric.limits: Synthetic lists without selected format. No tournament legality, optimality, draw probability or exhaustive combo absence claimed. Expectations handwritten before inference.

Countermagic, draw, removal, sweepers and token finishers support Control.
Cheap haste pressure and Bolt alongside token production. Burn is secondary because only Bolt directly damages players.
Acceleration supports an expensive token finisher; landfall counters are secondary.
Counter amplification and Oak tokens without Denizen or another identified self-sustaining re-trigger in this complete list.
Denizen counter on Oak creates a green Squirrel, which re-triggers Denizen. Requires both permanents, an initial trigger, choosing to continue and no disruption; not inevitable victory.
Sacrifice, draw and graveyard return form a resource-recycling value shell. No specifically supported self-sustaining loop.
